name: PointSplat
definition: A geometry-driven prune-and-refine framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting that bridges gaussian pruning and transformer refinement, enabling high-quality reconstruction of compact Gaussians without requiring per-scene optimization at deployment.
summary: PointSplat is a geometry-driven prune-and-refine framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses intrinsic 3D attributes for pruning and a dual-branch transformer to decouple geometry and appearance, avoiding per-scene optimization.
